title: Just Bert
description: This project adds our favourite character... Bert!
body:
# BERT IS NOW IN MINECRAFT Bert was an inside joke in my friendgroup and I said why not and made Bert into reality and now even YOU can have YOUR own bert in Minecraft! ![Bert in its natural habitat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6bf3b2315c1086afd35efdb6a041bf5138c0b5d9.png) In this fine image we can see our fabulous Bert in all its glory. Look that smoke from its exhaust... look, its a beautiful, beautiful thing ~~----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~ In all reality, this mod just adds at current moment one singular mob called Bert into the game, Bert behaves like a normal mob you can tame and lead to your base and... let it be there In future updates I will add more content when I feel like it Credits:
Code: TyrForge
Models: JTG
